keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «겨울에 먹을 것이 없어 배가 고팠다(문제)» 와 «미래를 위해 준비하는 것이 현명하다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the grasshopper had no food in winter) and the lesson (it is wise to prepare for the future). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The grasshopper had no food in winter.

qs.q: Why was the grasshopper hungry in winter?
opts: He had no food at all.
The ant ate all his food.
He was sick in the snow.
evs: A grasshopper watched her and laughed.
The grasshopper was hungry because he had no food at all.
She carried seeds and grain to her home under the ground.
One hot summer, an ant worked hard every day.
why: 베짱이는 먹을 것이 하나도 없어서 배가 고팠다고 본문에 그대로 나와요. 개미가 음식을 먹었다거나 아팠다는 말은 없어요.
The text says he was hungry because he had no food at all. Nothing says the ant ate his food or that he was sick.

qs.q: The ant says, "I am saving food for winter." What does "saving" mean here?
qs.qko: 개미가 "I am saving food for winter."라고 해요. 여기서 "saving"은 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: "Why do you work so hard?" he asked. "Come and sing with me!"
"I am saving food for winter," said the ant, and she kept working.
The grasshopper played music and slept in the sun all summer long.
A grasshopper watched her and laughed.
why: «for winter(겨울을 위해)» 라는 말이 단서예요. 지금 먹는 것이 아니라 나중에 쓰려고 모아 두는 것이에요.
The words «for winter» are the clue. She is keeping the food to use later, not eating it now.

qs.q: Why did the ant have food to share in winter?
qs.qko: 개미는 왜 겨울에 나누어 줄 음식이 있었나요?
opts: She carried and saved food all summer.
She found food in the snow.
evs: She carried seeds and grain to her home under the ground.
The grasshopper played music and slept in the sun all summer long.
"I am saving food for winter," said the ant, and she kept working.
The grasshopper was hungry because he had no food at all.
why: 개미는 여름에 씨앗과 곡식을 집으로 나르고, 겨울을 위해 음식을 모았어요. 이 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
The ant carried seeds and grain home, and she saved food for winter. Put these two clues together to find the answer.

ends: Next summer, the grasshopper works with the ant.
다음 여름, 베짱이가 개미와 함께 일해요.
The grasshopper teaches the ant to sing in winter.
겨울 동안 베짱이가 개미에게 노래를 가르쳐 줘요.

write.src: “I think <u>the ant is wise</u> because <u>she saves food for winter</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.

chips.b: she is singing in the kitchen
chips.label: happy

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because she works hard)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because she works hard)

scenes.1: A green grasshopper holding a small violin laughs on a leaf in the summer sun as a small red ant walks past him carrying grain toward a little hole in the ground.
scenes.2: A cold winter field covered with snow; the green grasshopper with his small violin sits alone and shivers next to bare, frozen plants.
